attchmntText: EAAA India Alternatives Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
voiceSummary: EAAA India Alternatives Limited has uploaded the audio recording of its earnings call for the second quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The call was conducted on November 11, 2026. The recording is available on the company website at the specified URL. This filing is pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The company previously intimated about the earnings call on November 5, 2026. The audio file is hosted at https://www.eaaa.in/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/10049228.mp3. Deepak Mukhija, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, signed the communication. The company requests the exchanges to take the filing on record.

attchmntText: EAAA India Alternatives Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: EAAA India Alternatives Limited filed an earnings update for the half year ended September 30, 2026. Fee paying assets under management grew 28% year on year to 49,164 crore rupees. Total income increased 35% to 616 crore rupees. Profit after tax rose 35% to 169 crore rupees. Return on equity reached 29.4%. The company declared an interim dividend of 7 rupees per share for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027. The face value of the shares is 5 rupees.

attchmntText: EAAA India Alternatives Limited has informed the Exchange that Record date for the purpose of Dividend is 17-Nov-2026.
voiceSummary: EAAA India Alternatives Limited has declared a second interim dividend for the financial year 2026-27. The Board of Directors approved this declaration during its meeting held on November 11, 2026. The dividend is set at a rate of Rs. 7 per equity share. Each share has a face value of Rs. 5. The payment will be made from the company's profits. The record date for this dividend has been fixed as Tuesday, November 17, 2026. Equity shareholders whose names appear in the Register of Members, Beneficial Owners, or Depositories as of November 17, 2026, are eligible to receive the payment. The company informed the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited of this decision pursuant to SEBI Listing Regulations.

attchmntText: EAAA India Alternatives Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: EAAA India Alternatives Limited approved un-audited financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported a half-year profit after tax of 169 crore rupees, up 35 percent year-on-year, and a second-quarter profit after tax of 88 crore rupees. Fee-paying assets under management reached 49,164 crore rupees, a 28 percent increase. Total income for the half-year was 616 crore rupees. The board declared a second interim dividend of 7 rupees per equity share for the financial year 2026-27. The company confirmed no new issuance of non-convertible securities during the quarter. The results were reviewed by the audit committee and approved by the board of directors on November 11, 2026.
